# User Stories — Five Throws

## Core gameplay

- As a player, I want to choose from five signs (Rock, Paper, Scissors, Lizard, Spock) instead of three, so that matches have more strategic depth than classic RPS.
- As a player, I want to play a best-of-3, 5, or 7 match, so that one lucky or unlucky round doesn't decide the whole outcome.
- As a player, I want a live scoreboard and round-by-round progress pips, so that I always know how close the match is to ending.
- As a player, I want clear win/lose/draw feedback explaining which sign beat which, so that I understand the result, not just see it.

## AI opponent

- As a player, I want to choose an opponent difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard), so that I can match the challenge to my skill level.
- As a player, I want the AI to genuinely adapt to my play patterns on Medium and Hard, so that repeating the same sign has a real cost instead of the AI just being relabeled random chance.
- As a player, I want to see why the AI threw what it did after each round, so that I can learn from its strategy instead of treating it as a black box.
- As a player facing Hard difficulty, I want the AI to occasionally bluff instead of always countering, so that I can't exploit a 100%-predictable counter pattern.

## Local two-player mode

- As two players sharing one device, we want a pass-and-play mode, so that we can compete against each other instead of only the computer.
- As player two, I want my sign kept hidden from player one until I've chosen mine, so that the round stays fair and neither of us can react to the other's pick.

## Timing and pacing

- As a player, I want an optional per-round timer, so that matches can have urgency when I want that.
- As a player who prefers to think without pressure, I want to turn the timer off entirely, so that I can play at my own pace.
- As a player who runs out of time, I want a random throw thrown on my behalf rather than an automatic loss, so that one slow round doesn't feel unfairly punishing.

## Personalization

- As a player, I want to enter my name, so that the match feels like mine rather than generic.
- As a player, I want to switch between light and dark themes, so that I can play comfortably in different lighting conditions.
- As a player, I want to toggle sound on or off, so that I can play quietly when needed.
- As a player sensitive to motion, I want an option to reduce animation, so that the game doesn't cause discomfort.

## Progress and persistence

- As a returning player, I want my last 5 matches saved, so that I can see how I've been doing over time.
- As a returning player, I want my best-ever win streak remembered, so that I have a personal record to chase.
- As a player, I want to see my all-time favorite throw, so that I learn something about my own habits, not just the match outcome.
- As a player, I want to unlock badges for specific accomplishments (first win, a flawless match, a comeback, beating Hard, using every sign, outsmarting a deliberate AI read, winning a local match), so that I have goals beyond just winning the current match.

## Accessibility

- As a keyboard-only player, I want every throw mapped to a number key, so that I never need a mouse to play a full match.
- As a screen reader user, I want round results, timeouts, and badge unlocks announced, so that I don't have to rely on seeing the screen to follow the game.
- As a player navigating by keyboard, I want visible focus states on every control, so that I always know what's currently active.
